title: MAGPIE: Alignment Data Synthesis from Scratch by Prompting Aligned LLMs with Nothing
data_curation: MAGPIE synthesizes alignment data from the observation that feeding an aligned LLM only its pre-query template (e.g., Llama-3's user header) makes it auto-regressively emit a plausible user query, with no seed questions or prompt engineering. A two-step pipeline (generate instruction, then generate response) is run on Llama-3-8B-Instruct (MAGPIE-Air, 3M convs / 1.28B tokens) and Llama-3-70B-Instruct (MAGPIE-Pro, 1M convs / 477M tokens), plus Llama-3.1, Qwen2, Gemma-2, Phi-3 (over 11.4M instructions total). Cost is ~$0.12 per 1k instances (Air) and $1.1 per 1k (Pro) on A100s with vLLM, with no GPT-4 API calls. Quality and difficulty are auto-labeled by Llama-3-8B-Instruct; safety is checked by Llama-Guard-2 (<1% unsafe). Filtering exposes 8 metrics (input/output length, task category, input quality, input difficulty, min-neighbor FAISS distance, reward, reward difference) with 6 off-the-shelf configs. Extensions cover multi-turn (MAGPIE-MT), preference data (k=5 samples, T=0.8, ArmoRM scoring), and domain/multilingual via system prompts.
curriculum: Not a focus of this paper. The work studies only a simple SFT-then-optional-DPO ordering—cosine LR 2e-5, 2 epochs for SFT (Axolotl), then DPO with cosine LR 5e-7, 1 epoch (Alignment Handbook) on MAGPIE-DPO data—to demonstrate that MAGPIE-SFT alone can match or beat baselines that used SFT+DPO; MagpieLM uses 550K SFT plus 200K DPO instructions, and a 150K math/code/reasoning 'booster' set is mixed into MAGPIE-Pro-Filtered to fix a reasoning weakness (MAGPIE-Pro-Mix).
method: The core contribution is seed-free self-synthesis: because aligned models were fine-tuned on the pre-query template format, feeding only that template triggers the model to sample a real user instruction before emitting EOS (Step 1); the instruction is then wrapped with pre+post-query templates and the same LLM generates the response, optionally greedily to favor high-probability, training-derived tokens (Step 2). This avoids the diversity collapse and seed dependence of Self-Instruct/Evol-Instruct. Preference data is built by sampling k=5 responses at T=0.8 and labeling the highest/lowest reward-model (ArmoRM) score as chosen/rejected for DPO. Multi-turn appends the pre-query template with a role-reinforcing system prompt; domain/multilingual control uses tailored system prompts (math, code, Chinese, etc.) or specialized models such as DeepSeek-Coder-V2 and Qwen2-Math. Higher temperature/top-p trades quality for difficulty and diversity.
eval_metrics: Models are evaluated on AlpacaEval 2 (805 prompts; GPT-4-Turbo-1106 and Llama-3-8B-Instruct baselines), Arena-Hard (500 queries; GPT-4-0314 baseline), and WildBench (1024 real-user tasks), using win rate (WR) and length-controlled win rate (LC) with a GPT-4 judge. Downstream ability is measured on the Open LLM Leaderboard (MMLU, ARC, HellaSwag, TruthfulQA, WinoGrande, GSM8K, MMLU-Redux) and trustworthiness via TrustLLM. Headline: Llama-3-8B-Base SFT on MAGPIE-Pro-300K-Filtered beats all SFT baselines and even UltraChat-SFT + UltraFeedback-DPO; adding MAGPIE-Pro-DPO reaches AlpacaEval2 LC 50.10% and WR 53.53% vs the official model, surpassing both Llama-3-8B-Instruct and GPT-4-Turbo. MagpieLM-8B-Chat tops <10B open models (LC 58.18, ArenaHard 48.54, WildBench 42.70).
key_results: Llama-3-8B-Base + MAGPIE-Pro-300K-Filtered SFT + MAGPIE-Pro-DPO reaches AlpacaEval2 LC 50.10% vs GPT-4-Turbo and WR 53.53% vs official Llama-3-8B-Instruct, surpassing both while using only ~400K data versus >10M. MAGPIE SFT alone outperforms every baseline SFT dataset and even baselines using SFT+DPO with UltraFeedback. MagpieLM-8B-Chat ranks #1 among <10B open models: AlpacaEval2 LC 58.18, ArenaHard 48.54, WildBench 42.70.
evolution_note: MAGPIE (2024) extends synthetic-instruction lines such as Self-Instruct, Evol-Instruct, and UltraChat by removing their seed-question and prompt-engineering dependence, instead extracting an aligned model's own instruction distribution via its chat template. It reacts to the closed alignment data of open-weight models like Llama-3-Instruct to democratize alignment data, and enables later seed-free self-distillation and self-alignment pipelines that require large synthetic SFT and preference corpora.
